feedback.details: countSprintHeadings in sprint-count.ts uses /^##\s*Sprint\s+\d+/gim with multiline flag. Tests in phase-1-5-integration.test.ts cover inline prose, blockquotes, acceptance criteria, indented headings, and backtick-quoted references. All 6 tests pass. Spec with 2 line-start headings + inline references yields 2.

Resume path loads existing progress, reads spec from disk, skips completed sprints. loadExistingContract reuses contracts from disk. New timestamped logs created via createConversationLog. revertToCheckpoint uses git reset --hard with stash/unstash. Tests cover contract reuse, distinct timestamps, stash survival. 3 git-ops tests fail in full suite but pass in isolation (test environment pollution, not code issue).

commitAdhdMetadata in git-ops.ts creates [adhd] commits with contracts/feedback/progress/spec. --commit-adhd-logs additionally stages .adhd/logs/. Config resolution correctly implements commitAdhd: cli.commitAdhd || cli.commitAdhdLogs (implication). Default is false. Tests verify parsing, commit message format, includeLogs behavior.

notify() in notifications.ts always emits \x07 to stdout. With notify: true, dispatches desktop notification via notify-send (Linux) or osascript (macOS). All HITL gates call notify() before prompting. Fatal error in index.ts calls notify(). Tests verify bell emission and flag parsing. 5 tests pass.

HarnessProgress status union includes 'documenting'. Status transitions: planning (initial) → spec-review → negotiating → building → evaluating → (loop) → documenting → complete. 'documenting' set at harness.ts:550 before runDocumenterPhase. 'complete' set at harness.ts:564. 3 dedicated tests pass.

parseContract writes diagnostic file via writeParseErrorDiagnostic on failure. Directory created with mkdir recursive. Truncated preview (500 char cap) logged to console. Successful parses produce no diagnostic. Tests verify file creation, content preservation, truncation for long input, and no diagnostic on success.

All conversation logs use fileTimestamp() for YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS prefix via createConversationLog. Tests verify generator, evaluator, contract-negotiation, and documenter logs all have timestamp prefix. Multiple runs produce distinct files. Chronological ordering verified in tests.

commitAdhdArtifacts called at sprint-attempts.ts:42 immediately before generator invocation. Stages and commits all .adhd/ files with [adhd] prefix. Test verifies clean working tree (git status --porcelain returns empty) after commit. No-op when nothing to commit.

README.md contains dedicated sections for --notify (line 350), --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs (line 364). --resume documented at line 46 and 104. Usage examples provided for all flags. 'implies' interaction documented at line 374: 'This flag implies --commit-adhd'. Configuration table at lines 326-328 lists all flags with defaults. Tests at phase-1-5-integration.test.ts:749-760 verify README content and all pass.

Most catch blocks properly log with context or re-throw. One borderline case: harness.ts:219 catches errors from runDocumenterPhase with only a comment '// Documenter failure is non-fatal' — but runDocumenterPhase internally logs errors at sprint-success.ts:171, so errors aren't truly lost. Several catch blocks in skills.ts (lines 247, 256, 276, 294) silently continue but have inline comments explaining why. git-ops.ts:132 is 'best effort' with comment. No completely empty catch blocks found.

Functions: camelCase (commitAdhdArtifacts, fileTimestamp, loadExistingContract, countSprintHeadings). Types: PascalCase (HarnessProgress, SprintContract, AgentRunners, ConversationLogger). Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (CLI_FLAG_HELP, CLAUDE_MODEL, PARSE_ERROR_PREVIEW_LENGTH). Files: kebab-case throughout (git-ops.ts, sprint-count.ts, conversation-logger.ts). No abbreviations without precedent.

fileTimestamp is the single timestamp utility in logger.ts. notify() is the single notification dispatch in notifications.ts. commitAdhdArtifacts and commitAdhdMetadata handle distinct commit scenarios without duplication. createConversationLog is the single log creation point. Git operations centralized in git-ops.ts.

grep for '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk' or any provider SDK in shared/ returns zero matches. All Claude-specific code lives in harness-claude/. AgentRunners DI interface in shared/orchestration/types.ts is the bridge. Perfect separation maintained.
Running 'bunx biome check .' produces 'Checked 38 files in 78ms. No fixes applied.' Zero errors and zero warnings.
sprint-count.ts uses /^##\s*Sprint\s+\d+/gim — ^ anchor with m (multiline) flag. Only column-1 headings matched.
Test in phase-1-5-integration.test.ts confirms spec with '## Sprint 1' and '## Sprint 2' as headings plus prose 'Sprint 3' and blockquoted '> ## Sprint 3' yields count of 2. All tests pass.
Test confirms 4 line-start '## Sprint N' headings yield count of 4. Passes.

All log filenames use YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS prefix via fileTimestamp(). Tests validate with /^\d{4}\.\d{2}\.\d{2}-\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{2}/ regex. Format confirmed for generator, evaluator, contract-negotiation, and documenter logs.
Tests in phase-1-5-integration.test.ts verify that multiple runs produce distinct timestamped files. Pre-generated timestamps used to prove files coexist. Original files remain on disk.
Test confirms contract-negotiation log uses YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS prefix and contains 'sprint-3-contract-negotiation.md'. Passes.
Tests verify generator, evaluator, contract-negotiation, and documenter logs all use timestamp prefix. createConversationLog always applies fileTimestamp(). No non-timestamped log writes found.

fileTimestamp() in logger.ts uses configured timezone via displayTz variable. Fallback to UTC on invalid timezone with debug logging. setDisplayTimezone called from index.ts when tzDisplay is configured.

Sprint attempt spans use fileTimestamp() in their names (sprint-attempts.ts:24). Documenter span uses documenterTs (sprint-success.ts:118). ConversationLogger exposes timestampedName property. Span names include the same timestamp identifier.
sprint-count.test.ts and phase-1-5-integration.test.ts both cover: standard headings counted, inline prose not counted, blockquoted/indented lines not counted. Multiple test variants.
loadExistingContract in files.ts reads from .adhd/contracts/sprint-N.json. Tests in resume-contract-skip.test.ts and phase-1-5-integration.test.ts verify loading without negotiation. Passes.
loadExistingContract returns null when file doesn't exist, which triggers normal negotiation flow. Tests verify this path.
Log message emitted when contract loaded from disk including criteria count. Tests verify log output.
loadExistingContract validates JSON parsing and structure. Malformed files return null, triggering negotiation rather than crashing. Tests verify with invalid JSON input.
parseContract calls writeParseErrorDiagnostic which writes to .adhd/logs/sprint-N-contract-parse-error.txt. Full raw text preserved in file. Tests verify file creation and content.
On parse failure, console log shows truncated preview. PARSE_ERROR_PREVIEW_LENGTH caps at 500 chars. Truncation indicator ('... (truncated, N chars total)') appended. Tests verify with long input.
Successful parse produces no diagnostic file. Tests verify no sprint-N-contract-parse-error.txt exists after successful parsing.
Directory created with mkdir recursive before writing diagnostic file. Tests verify this works even when .adhd/logs/ doesn't exist.
PARSE_ERROR_PREVIEW_LENGTH is 500 characters. Truncated preview includes '... (truncated, N chars total)' indicator. Reasonable for console readability.
commitAdhdArtifacts called at sprint-attempts.ts:42 immediately before generator invocation. Stages .adhd/ files and commits with [adhd] prefix. Tests verify clean tree after commit.
Commit message format is '[adhd] Sprint N: artifacts' (git-ops.ts:33). Tests verify prefix and sprint number inclusion. All pass in isolation.
After commitAdhdArtifacts, git status --porcelain on .adhd/ returns empty. Test at git-ops.test.ts:127-137 verifies this. Passes in isolation.
revertToCheckpoint at git-ops.ts:156 uses 'git reset --hard <sha>'. No git revert calls remain. Test verifies HEAD matches checkpoint SHA after reset. Passes in isolation.
stashAdhdFiles called before reset, unstashAdhdFiles after. Tests verify .adhd/progress.json and contracts survive revert with preserved content. Passes in isolation.

stashAdhdFiles catches errors and returns false with logged message (git-ops.ts:110-112). unstashAdhdFiles catches errors, logs them, and attempts conflict resolution (git-ops.ts:123-135). Revert completes even if stash fails. Test at git-ops.test.ts:239-259 verifies.

HarnessProgress status union at types.ts:128 includes 'documenting' alongside planning, spec-review, negotiating, building, evaluating, complete. TypeScript compilation succeeds (tsc --noEmit passes).
harness.ts:550 sets progress.status = 'documenting' before runDocumenterPhase call. Tests in documenting-status.test.ts verify the transition. All 3 tests pass.
harness.ts:564 sets progress.status = 'complete' after documenter phase. 'documenting' is transient. Tests verify the full lifecycle transition.
revertToCheckpoint is called from harness.ts during resume flows. The reset-based implementation handles HEAD-matches-checkpoint case (no-op) and stash/unstash. Tests verify existing patterns work.
commitAdhdArtifacts checks staged diff before committing (git-ops.ts:27-31). If nothing staged, returns early. Test at git-ops.test.ts:117-125 verifies no empty commit is created. Passes.
notify() always writes \x07 to stdout (notifications.ts:21). Called at all HITL gates including spec approval, contract preview, dirty tree check, evaluator override, and mid-run steering.
Fatal error handler in index.ts calls notify() which emits \x07. Terminal bell emitted on fatal errors.
CLI accepts --notify flag. Parsed in config.ts parseCli(). ResolvedConfig has notify: boolean (types.ts:82). Default is false. Tests verify parsing.
When notify: true, sendDesktopNotification uses notify-send (Linux) or osascript (macOS). Platform detection via process.platform. Subprocess failures logged as debug, not fatal.
When sendDesktop is false (default), only terminal bell emitted (notifications.ts:24). No desktop notification subprocess spawned. Tests verify.
CLI accepts --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs. Parsed into config with boolean properties commitAdhd and commitAdhdLogs. --help output documents both flags.
commitAdhdMetadata (git-ops.ts:53) stages .adhd/contracts/, .adhd/feedback/, .adhd/progress.json, .adhd/spec.md and commits with '[adhd] Sprint N: contract + metadata'. Tests verify.
When includeLogs is true, .adhd/logs/ is added to pathsToStage (git-ops.ts:60-62). Commit message appends '(including logs)'. Tests verify.
Config resolution sets commitAdhd = cli.commitAdhd || cli.commitAdhdLogs. When --commit-adhd-logs provided without --commit-adhd, commitAdhd is still true. Tests verify implication.
When neither flag provided, commitAdhd and commitAdhdLogs default to false. No [adhd] metadata commits created. Tests verify default behavior.
Entry point starts cleanly with new flags. --help documents --notify, --commit-adhd, --commit-adhd-logs. Running without prompt gives clear error message. TypeScript compilation succeeds.

overallSummary: Sprint 5 is well-executed. All criteria pass the threshold. 581 of 584 tests pass (3 failures are test isolation issues — all pass individually). README now fully documents --notify, --commit-adhd, and --commit-adhd-logs with usage examples. Biome lint is clean. SDK separation is perfect. Code quality is solid with consistent naming, no duplication, and proper error handling throughout. The only minor concern is a redundant catch block in harness.ts:219 that silently catches documenter errors, though the inner function already logs them.
